positions.as_written: Confirm on the coronal images, where the same tear appears as a line running from the free edge towards the capsule.
Decide whether the line reaches an articular surface, since that is what makes it a tear rather than intrasubstance degeneration.
Assess the cartilage in the same compartment, because the tear and the wear usually travel together.
A displaced leaf is a different proposition from a stable split, and displacement is what the imaging should be asked about.
